title: Business Analyst - AI Internship
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a motivated and analytical Business Analyst - AI Intern to join our Customer Success team. This internship is ideal for candidates who have strong business acumen, communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills and are interested in working with clients and cross-functional teams. The intern will gain hands-on exposure to business analysis, client management, requirement gathering, documentation, reporting, process improvement, and AI-powered productivity. You will work closely with clients and internal teams to understand requirements, track deliverables, coordinate follow-ups, and support the successful execution of client requirements. Responsibilities Assist in understanding and documenting client requirements and business needs. Participate in client meetings and maintain professional communication. Track requirements, tasks, deliverables, timelines, and action items. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely completion of requirements. Follow up on open tasks and issues until closure. Maintain accurate records of client interactions, requirements, and updates. Prepare meeting minutes, trackers, presentations, reports, and business documentation. Assist in preparing BRDs, FRDs, UAT reports, requirement documents, and process documentation. Identify business gaps, challenges, and potential issues and assist in finding solutions. Understand existing business processes and identify opportunities for improvement. Support the Customer Success team in maintaining strong client relationships. Collaborate with cross-functional teams for smooth execution of client activities. Manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Use AI tools to improve research, documentation, analysis, reporting, communication, and productivity. Explore emerging AI tools and identify practical ways to improve business processes. AI Tools & Digital Skills Familiarity with tools such as: ChatGPT | Gemini | Claude | Microsoft Copilot | Other AI PlatformsYou will be encouraged to use AI for: Research and information gathering Documentation and report preparation Data analysis and business insights Creating presentations and business content Improving communication and workflows Exploring new AI tools and technologies Identifying opportunities for AI-driven process improvement Prior experience with AI tools is not mandatory. Curiosity, willingness to experiment, and eagerness to learn are highly valued. Preferred Qualification Bachelor's degree or equivalent Final-year students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply Candidates interested in Business Analysis, Customer Success, Consulting, Client Management, or AI & Business Transformation are preferred. Essential Skills Strong business acumen and analytical thinking Understanding of business requirements and processes Excellent verbal and written communication Strong client communication and interpersonal skills Good coordination and follow-up skills Strong organizational and time-management abilities Attention to detail Structured problem-solving approach Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities Proactive and ownership-driven mindset Willingness to learn and work with AI tools

Key Skills: business analyst,data analysis,customer success,time management,ai,business analysis,process improvement,communication and interpersonal skills
